description: Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance for one of the user's sites (paid plans; data comes from the whywontai Chrome extension or a CSV upload): the grounding queries Microsoft Copilot and Bing AI used to find the site, with intent, topic, citations, citation share and the pages cited. Flags buying queries (Commercial, Comparison, Transactional, Shopping) cited to a weaker page, queries split across two own pages, low citation share and drops since the earlier period. Read-only.
